description: Finds the three lowest current prices on Amazon.com (United States) for a product. Checks up to 120 listings: best matches, lowest priced and top rated. Returns title, price in US dollars, picture and a link to buy for each. A fresh search takes about 15 seconds.

fast.description: Set true for a first look in about 2 seconds (lowest prices from the first 10 best matches). Leave out for the full check of up to 120 listings, which takes about 20 seconds the first time and is instant when recently checked.

four_stars.description: Only items rated 4 stars and up

max_price.description: Optional top price in US dollars

query.description: What the shopper wants, in plain words. Example: black wireless earbuds

name: find_lowest_price
title: Find the lowest price on Amazon
